units.rawText: The alarm rings again, reminding me that someone is waiting on the other end of the transmission. I quickly set aside the memory fragment reader and pick up the line.
units.displayText: The alarm rings again, reminding me that someone is waiting on the other end of the transmission. I quickly set aside the memory fragment reader and pick up the line.

units.rawText: Good evening, Professor. This is the scheduled communication from the Guardians. De Lacey here, once again arriving just in time to lend you a helping hand~
units.displayText: Good evening, Professor. This is the scheduled communication from the Guardians. De Lacey here, once again arriving just in time to lend you a helping hand~

spans.text: Good evening, Professor. This is the scheduled communication from the Guardians. De Lacey here, once again arriving just in time to lend you a helping hand~

units.rawText: Can you hear me clearly, Professor?
units.displayText: Can you hear me clearly, Professor?

spans.text: Can you hear me clearly, Professor?

units.rawText: As always, the call is as lively as ever on the other side of the screen.
units.displayText: As always, the call is as lively as ever on the other side of the screen.

spans.text: As always, the call is as lively as ever on the other side of the screen.

units.rawText: Everything is in order. Unlike in previous sectors, we haven't encountered any interference with communications.
units.displayText: Everything is in order. Unlike in previous sectors, we haven't encountered any interference with communications.

spans.text: Everything is in order. Unlike in previous sectors, we haven't encountered any interference with communications.

units.rawText: Okie-dokie. Then our communication shouldn't be interrupted.

units.rawText: Sigh... Look at Bonneville and Shale—they get to visit the Oasis in person as the Guardians' representatives, while I can only speak to Professor through this...
units.displayText: Sigh... Look at Bonneville and Shale—they get to visit the Oasis in person as the Guardians' representatives, while I can only speak to Professor through this...

spans.text: Sigh... Look at Bonneville and Shale—they get to visit the Oasis in person as the Guardians' representatives, while I can only speak to Professor through this...

units.rawText: I'm more than happy to have you at the Oasis too. What do you say to that?
units.displayText: I'm more than happy to have you at the Oasis too. What do you say to that?

spans.text: I'm more than happy to have you at the Oasis too. What do you say to that?

units.rawText: Of course, I'd love to see you at the Oasis, Professor! But I still have missions to handle...
units.displayText: Of course, I'd love to see you at the Oasis, Professor! But I still have missions to handle...

spans.text: Of course, I'd love to see you at the Oasis, Professor! But I still have missions to handle...

units.rawText: Missions... Let me guess, said missions are related to the Ascension Sector, well-renowned for its prosthetics?
units.displayText: Missions... Let me guess, said missions are related to the Ascension Sector, well-renowned for its prosthetics?

spans.text: Missions... Let me guess, said missions are related to the Ascension Sector, well-renowned for its prosthetics?

units.rawText: Eh?
units.displayText: Eh?

spans.text: Eh?

units.rawText: Surprised, she covers her mouth with her hand. As she regains her composure, a cunning smile spreads across her face.
units.displayText: Surprised, she covers her mouth with her hand. As she regains her composure, a cunning smile spreads across her face.

spans.text: Surprised, she covers her mouth with her hand. As she regains her composure, a cunning smile spreads across her face.

units.rawText: So, you've investigated thoroughly... Professor, you're quite the sly one, pretending to know nothing when it comes to information.
units.displayText: So, you've investigated thoroughly... Professor, you're quite the sly one, pretending to know nothing when it comes to information.

spans.text: So, you've investigated thoroughly... Professor, you're quite the sly one, pretending to know nothing when it comes to information.

units.rawText: And may I assume this is the main topic of today's communication?
units.displayText: And may I assume this is the main topic of today's communication?

spans.text: And may I assume this is the main topic of today's communication?

units.rawText: Just throwing out my hypothesis. But now that I think about it, doesn't Arcadia seem largely unaffected by the Entropic crisis?
units.displayText: Just throwing out my hypothesis. But now that I think about it, doesn't Arcadia seem largely unaffected by the Entropic crisis?

spans.text: Just throwing out my hypothesis. But now that I think about it, doesn't Arcadia seem largely unaffected by the Entropic crisis?

units.rawText: After all, in such a situation, you still have the forces to support other sectors... or might it be because that these sectors received protection from the Guardians, that your Boss has to divide your forces like this?
units.displayText: After all, in such a situation, you still have the forces to support other sectors... or might it be because that these sectors received protection from the Guardians, that your Boss has to divide your forces like this?

units.rawText: Because at the end of the day, it's the Guardians who activated the Sandbox Barriers for the other sectors, and...

units.displayText: The Doll on the other end of the line covers her ears and closes her eyes in a panic, trying to escape the conversation.

units.rawText: I didn't hear anything, I didn't hear anything...
units.displayText: I didn't hear anything, I didn't hear anything...

spans.text: I didn't hear anything, I didn't hear anything...

units.rawText: W-What is it?
units.displayText: W-What is it?

spans.text: W-What is it?

units.rawText: (Cough) Professor, if you're looking into matters like this, don't you think it'd be better if I knew nothing about it?
units.displayText: (Cough) Professor, if you're looking into matters like this, don't you think it'd be better if I knew nothing about it?

spans.text: (Cough) Professor, if you're looking into matters like this, don't you think it'd be better if I knew nothing about it?

units.rawText: Nonetheless, I really want to help you, Professor. However, I've neither the power nor the will to get involved in those matters. That's why I left <color=orange>Organization N</color>.
units.displayText: Nonetheless, I really want to help you, Professor. However, I've neither the power nor the will to get involved in those matters. That's why I left Organization N.

Organization N

units.rawText: What's Organization N?
units.displayText: What's Organization N?

spans.text: What's Organization N?

units.rawText: Organization N is a subgroup just one rank below the Boss in the Guardians, and many critical decisions go through N.
units.displayText: Organization N is a subgroup just one rank below the Boss in the Guardians, and many critical decisions go through N.

spans.text: Organization N is a subgroup just one rank below the Boss in the Guardians, and many critical decisions go through N.

units.rawText: Since our Boss has largely been inactive, they've effectively become the decision-makers of Arcadia.
units.displayText: Since our Boss has largely been inactive, they've effectively become the decision-makers of Arcadia.

spans.text: Since our Boss has largely been inactive, they've effectively become the decision-makers of Arcadia.

units.rawText: In other words, to meet your Boss, we'll need to prepare countermeasures against Organization N first?
units.displayText: In other words, to meet your Boss, we'll need to prepare countermeasures against Organization N first?

spans.text: In other words, to meet your Boss, we'll need to prepare countermeasures against Organization N first?

units.rawText: Umm, Professor, you're so blatantly aggressive in situations like this. No wonder Boss sent <color=orange>Sangoma</color> to the Oasis...
units.displayText: Umm, Professor, you're so blatantly aggressive in situations like this. No wonder Boss sent Sangoma to the Oasis...

Sangoma
to the Oasis...

units.rawText: Sangoma? That name rings a bell...
units.displayText: Sangoma? That name rings a bell...

spans.text: Sangoma? That name rings a bell...

units.rawText: Uh-oh, I just slipped up. I wasn't supposed to tell you that Sangoma is heading to the Oasis.
units.displayText: Uh-oh, I just slipped up. I wasn't supposed to tell you that Sangoma is heading to the Oasis.

spans.text: Uh-oh, I just slipped up. I wasn't supposed to tell you that Sangoma is heading to the Oasis.

units.rawText: Well... I suppose it doesn't matter at this point since you're going to meet her in no time, yeah?
units.displayText: Well... I suppose it doesn't matter at this point since you're going to meet her in no time, yeah?

spans.text: Well... I suppose it doesn't matter at this point since you're going to meet her in no time, yeah?

units.rawText: Her eyes show no trace of regret, making it clear she leaked the information intentionally. However, her expression suddenly shifts to seriousness as I begin to ask more about it.
units.displayText: Her eyes show no trace of regret, making it clear she leaked the information intentionally. However, her expression suddenly shifts to seriousness as I begin to ask more about it.

spans.text: Her eyes show no trace of regret, making it clear she leaked the information intentionally. However, her expression suddenly shifts to seriousness as I begin to ask more about it.

units.rawText: Sangoma is one of the most important figures in Organization N, and a woman not to be trifled with. Professor, please tread lightly!
units.displayText: Sangoma is one of the most important figures in Organization N, and a woman not to be trifled with. Professor, please tread lightly!

spans.text: Sangoma is one of the most important figures in Organization N, and a woman not to be trifled with. Professor, please tread lightly!

units.rawText: Why are you phrasing it like that... Huh?!
units.displayText: Why are you phrasing it like that... Huh?!

spans.text: Why are you phrasing it like that... Huh?!

units.rawText: If I hadn't looked up by coincidence, I never would have noticed a third person partaking in this call.
units.displayText: If I hadn't looked up by coincidence, I never would have noticed a third person partaking in this call.

spans.text: If I hadn't looked up by coincidence, I never would have noticed a third person partaking in this call.

units.rawText: Her presence is as faint as a ghost, slipping past all detection with nary a sound. The woman with long purple hair smiles as she notices my reaction.
units.displayText: Her presence is as faint as a ghost, slipping past all detection with nary a sound. The woman with long purple hair smiles as she notices my reaction.

spans.text: Her presence is as faint as a ghost, slipping past all detection with nary a sound. The woman with long purple hair smiles as she notices my reaction.

units.displayText: She puts down her weapon as a gesture of peace, then leans forward slightly, making a shhh gesture with her hand.

spans.text: She puts down her weapon as a gesture of peace, then leans forward slightly, making a shhh gesture with her hand.

units.rawText: (Shhhh...)
units.displayText: Shhhh...

units.displayText: A faint, yet familiar fragrance wafts from her movements. She holds her palm out toward me, presenting her badge to prove her purpose and identity.

spans.text: A faint, yet familiar fragrance wafts from her movements. She holds her palm out toward me, presenting her badge to prove her purpose and identity.

units.displayText: The Guardians' credentials...

units.rawText: She smiles and nods as we reach a silent consensus. Then, she makes another hand gesture, signaling me to continue the conversation.
units.displayText: She smiles and nods as we reach a silent consensus. Then, she makes another hand gesture, signaling me to continue the conversation.

spans.text: She smiles and nods as we reach a silent consensus. Then, she makes another hand gesture, signaling me to continue the conversation.

units.rawText: Hello? Professor? Is there something wrong?
units.displayText: Hello? Professor? Is there something wrong?

spans.text: Hello? Professor? Is there something wrong?

units.rawText: I only now realize that she's standing right behind the camera's blind spot. With all her attention focused on the conversation about Sangoma, De Lacey didn't notice anything unusual on my end.
units.displayText: I only now realize that she's standing right behind the camera's blind spot. With all her attention focused on the conversation about Sangoma, De Lacey didn't notice anything unusual on my end.

spans.text: I only now realize that she's standing right behind the camera's blind spot. With all her attention focused on the conversation about Sangoma, De Lacey didn't notice anything unusual on my end.

units.rawText: ...It's nothing. Just choked on my saliva. Where were we?
units.displayText: ...It's nothing. Just choked on my saliva. Where were we?

spans.text: ...It's nothing. Just choked on my saliva. Where were we?

units.rawText: I was about to say, be careful with Sangoma! Professor, you must stay vigilant and never let your guard down!
units.displayText: I was about to say, be careful with Sangoma! Professor, you must stay vigilant and never let your guard down!

spans.text: I was about to say, be careful with Sangoma! Professor, you must stay vigilant and never let your guard down!

units.rawText: She may look like a kind person with a sunny grin, but she's totes a control freak. She exerts her strict control over everything, no matter how trivial it may be. Professor, please don't be fooled by her friendly appearance!
units.displayText: She may look like a kind person with a sunny grin, but she's totes a control freak. She exerts her strict control over everything, no matter how trivial it may be. Professor, please don't be fooled by her friendly appearance!

spans.text: She may look like a kind person with a sunny grin, but she's totes a control freak. She exerts her strict control over everything, no matter how trivial it may be. Professor, please don't be fooled by her friendly appearance!

units.rawText: The girl on the other side of the table holds her chin with one hand while tapping the table with the other, gesturing as if she's waiting for my affirmation.
units.displayText: The girl on the other side of the table holds her chin with one hand while tapping the table with the other, gesturing as if she's waiting for my affirmation.

spans.text: The girl on the other side of the table holds her chin with one hand while tapping the table with the other, gesturing as if she's waiting for my affirmation.

units.rawText: ...What does she look like, if you don't mind me asking?
units.displayText: ...What does she look like, if you don't mind me asking?

spans.text: ...What does she look like, if you don't mind me asking?

units.rawText: Uh, I really don't want to picture her appearance while I'm chatting with you, Professor. But let's see—long purple hair, a black skirt, and a dangerously large scythe.
units.displayText: Uh, I really don't want to picture her appearance while I'm chatting with you, Professor. But let's see—long purple hair, a black skirt, and a dangerously large scythe.

spans.text: Uh, I really don't want to picture her appearance while I'm chatting with you, Professor. But let's see—long purple hair, a black skirt, and a dangerously large scythe.

units.displayText: Overhearing De Lacey's comment, the woman with long purple hair gently combs the strands dangling in front of her ears, then lightly swings the uncanny scythe in her hand.

spans.text: Overhearing De Lacey's comment, the woman with long purple hair gently combs the strands dangling in front of her ears, then lightly swings the uncanny scythe in her hand.

units.rawText: Oh, and her breasts... are way too charming! Even Boss mentioned how her allure could be dangerous to teenagers...

units.rawText: (Cough) Really now...
units.displayText: (Cough) Really now...

spans.text: (Cough) Really now...

units.rawText: Yep! She's about my size, but her bra size is much smaller than mine...
units.displayText: Yep! She's about my size, but her bra size is much smaller than mine...

spans.text: Yep! She's about my size, but her bra size is much smaller than mine...

units.displayText: The woman with the apparently smaller bra size lowers her head, seemingly annoyed by the comment. She moves her lips slowly in silence, as if urging me to lip-read. I do my best to decipher her words while still listening to De Lacey.

units.displayText: "My. Bra. Size. Is. Much. Bigger. Than. Hers."

units.rawText: ...That's where you disagree?!
units.displayText: ...That's where you disagree?!

units.displayText: Professor! Please pay attention! I'm not joking here!

units.rawText: Ahem. Alright, alright. Let's continue then... Did you say that Sangoma is very dangerous?
units.displayText: Ahem. Alright, alright. Let's continue then... Did you say that Sangoma is very dangerous?

spans.text: Ahem. Alright, alright. Let's continue then... Did you say that Sangoma is very dangerous?

units.rawText: Yes, Sangoma is a skilled herbalist and one of the first Dolls to join Project Neural Cloud.
units.displayText: Yes, Sangoma is a skilled herbalist and one of the first Dolls to join Project Neural Cloud.

spans.text: Yes, Sangoma is a skilled herbalist and one of the first Dolls to join Project Neural Cloud.

units.rawText: She's known for her firm approach, but her whereabouts remain a mystery. Every Guardian knows her name, yet few have worked with her directly.
units.displayText: She's known for her firm approach, but her whereabouts remain a mystery. Every Guardian knows her name, yet few have worked with her directly.

spans.text: She's known for her firm approach, but her whereabouts remain a mystery. Every Guardian knows her name, yet few have worked with her directly.

units.rawText: And you happen to be one of the few?
units.displayText: And you happen to be one of the few?

spans.text: And you happen to be one of the few?

units.rawText: Mm-hmm. That's exactly how I got to know her true character.
units.displayText: Mm-hmm. That's exactly how I got to know her true character.

spans.text: Mm-hmm. That's exactly how I got to know her true character.

units.displayText: Oho? And what might you mean by "true character"?

units.rawText: She'll do anything to achieve her goals, regardless of the methods... Wait, whose voice was that...

units.rawText: S-Sangoma...
units.displayText: S-Sangoma...

spans.text: S-Sangoma...

units.displayText: Hi there. Long time no see, De Lacey.

spans.text: Hi there. Long time no see, De Lacey.

units.displayText: The woman with purple hair walks to my side, grinning as she waves to the person on the other end of the line.

spans.text: The woman with purple hair walks to my side, grinning as she waves to the person on the other end of the line.

units.displayText: I appreciate you introducing me, but it would be rather rude to let you continue.

spans.text: I appreciate you introducing me, but it would be rather rude to let you continue.

units.rawText: Ah... haha, I didn't expect you to arrive at the Oasis so soon...
units.displayText: Ah... haha, I didn't expect you to arrive at the Oasis so soon...

spans.text: Ah... haha, I didn't expect you to arrive at the Oasis so soon...

units.rawText: I don't remember you being such a loudmouth, and especially not one who would risk breaking the Guardians' non-disclosure agreement just to tip others off. My, it seems like you really like <cmdr>.

units.rawText: It's my pleasure. I only "accidentally" disclosed a small part of your schedule, along with some personal comments.

spans.text: It's my pleasure. I only "accidentally" disclosed a small part of your schedule, along with some personal comments.

units.rawText: I know you want everything under your control, but you wouldn't happen to include other people's small opinions as something to be controlled as well, would you?
units.displayText: I know you want everything under your control, but you wouldn't happen to include other people's small opinions as something to be controlled as well, would you?

spans.text: I know you want everything under your control, but you wouldn't happen to include other people's small opinions as something to be controlled as well, would you?

units.displayText: The uncompromising tones from both sides further radicalize the already tense situation.

units.rawText: You really know when to bend the rules... Sure, we'll have a good and long chat about this later.

units.displayText: The door closes before us, leaving the vast Ops Room in silence. Only the sounds of breathing and faint mechanical humming lingers in the air.

spans.text: The door closes before us, leaving the vast Ops Room in silence. Only the sounds of breathing and faint mechanical humming lingers in the air.

units.rawText: ...This feels quite nostalgic. How long has it been since we last had a moment alone like this?
units.displayText: ...This feels quite nostalgic. How long has it been since we last had a moment alone like this?

spans.text: ...This feels quite nostalgic. How long has it been since we last had a moment alone like this?

units.rawText: Her gaze sweeps across every corner of the Ops Room before finally locking on me.
units.displayText: Her gaze sweeps across every corner of the Ops Room before finally locking on me.

spans.text: Her gaze sweeps across every corner of the Ops Room before finally locking on me.

units.rawText: But the current you doesn't remember any of it, hmm?
units.displayText: But the current you doesn't remember any of it, hmm?

spans.text: But the current you doesn't remember any of it, hmm?

units.rawText: Do you have any leads on my memory loss?
units.displayText: Do you have any leads on my memory loss?

spans.text: Do you have any leads on my memory loss?

units.rawText: ...You're just as impatient as ever.
units.displayText: ...You're just as impatient as ever.

spans.text: ...You're just as impatient as ever.

units.rawText: Sangoma sighs and walks directly toward me.
units.displayText: Sangoma sighs and walks directly toward me.

spans.text: Sangoma sighs and walks directly toward me.

units.rawText: She extends her hand and gently touches my forehead, sadness plastered across her countenance.
units.displayText: She extends her hand and gently touches my forehead, sadness plastered across her countenance.

spans.text: She extends her hand and gently touches my forehead, sadness plastered across her countenance.

units.rawText: Look at these new wrinkles around your brows... Have you been staying up all night again?
units.displayText: Look at these new wrinkles around your brows... Have you been staying up all night again?

spans.text: Look at these new wrinkles around your brows... Have you been staying up all night again?

units.rawText: You always seem on edge. I know you want the best for your crew, but please remember to put yourself first...
units.displayText: You always seem on edge. I know you want the best for your crew, but please remember to put yourself first...

spans.text: You always seem on edge. I know you want the best for your crew, but please remember to put yourself first...

units.rawText: That inexplicable familiarity resurfaces. Every action Sangoma has taken so far feels natural, as though her behavior perfectly aligned with what I inherently expected.
units.displayText: That inexplicable familiarity resurfaces. Every action Sangoma has taken so far feels natural, as though her behavior perfectly aligned with what I inherently expected.

spans.text: That inexplicable familiarity resurfaces. Every action Sangoma has taken so far feels natural, as though her behavior perfectly aligned with what I inherently expected.

units.rawText: Without another word from me, Sangoma lets out another sigh and takes out a memory fragment out of nowhere.
units.displayText: Without another word from me, Sangoma lets out another sigh and takes out a memory fragment out of nowhere.

spans.text: Without another word from me, Sangoma lets out another sigh and takes out a memory fragment out of nowhere.

units.rawText: ...This is what's missing from your memory fragment. I'm here to give it to you, as promised.
units.displayText: ...This is what's missing from your memory fragment. I'm here to give it to you, as promised.

spans.text: ...This is what's missing from your memory fragment. I'm here to give it to you, as promised.

units.rawText: She walks beside the table and picks up my memory fragment. The two fragments merge into one, revealing a reflection of my face in its now-restored mirror-like surface.
units.displayText: She walks beside the table and picks up my memory fragment. The two fragments merge into one, revealing a reflection of my face in its now-restored mirror-like surface.

spans.text: She walks beside the table and picks up my memory fragment. The two fragments merge into one, revealing a reflection of my face in its now-restored mirror-like surface.

units.rawText: As light radiates from the fragment, an unknown memory drifts along with it, gradually filling the void in my mind.
units.displayText: As light radiates from the fragment, an unknown memory drifts along with it, gradually filling the void in my mind.

spans.text: As light radiates from the fragment, an unknown memory drifts along with it, gradually filling the void in my mind.

units.rawText: Countless images flash through my mind. Though I strain to see them clearly, they stay frustratingly blurred, and nothing I do seems to lift this fog in my memory.
units.displayText: Countless images flash through my mind. Though I strain to see them clearly, they stay frustratingly blurred, and nothing I do seems to lift this fog in my memory.

spans.text: Countless images flash through my mind. Though I strain to see them clearly, they stay frustratingly blurred, and nothing I do seems to lift this fog in my memory.

units.rawText: See? I didn't lie to you.
units.displayText: See? I didn't lie to you.

spans.text: See? I didn't lie to you.

units.rawText: But how did my memory fragment end up in your hands?
units.displayText: But how did my memory fragment end up in your hands?

spans.text: But how did my memory fragment end up in your hands?

units.rawText: ...That's going to be a long story, one built on countless efforts behind the scenes.
units.displayText: ...That's going to be a long story, one built on countless efforts behind the scenes.

spans.text: ...That's going to be a long story, one built on countless efforts behind the scenes.

units.rawText: We've finally found a ray of hope after numerous attempts. That's why I brought it to you, as a gesture of our earnest intentions for cooperation.
units.displayText: We've finally found a ray of hope after numerous attempts. That's why I brought it to you, as a gesture of our earnest intentions for cooperation.

spans.text: We've finally found a ray of hope after numerous attempts. That's why I brought it to you, as a gesture of our earnest intentions for cooperation.

units.rawText: Sangoma passes the fragment into my hands and gestures with her index finger, stopping me from asking more questions.
units.displayText: Sangoma passes the fragment into my hands and gestures with her index finger, stopping me from asking more questions.

spans.text: Sangoma passes the fragment into my hands and gestures with her index finger, stopping me from asking more questions.

units.rawText: I know you're looking for more answers to many other questions, but you still don't have all the pieces to solve the whole puzzle.
units.displayText: I know you're looking for more answers to many other questions, but you still don't have all the pieces to solve the whole puzzle.

spans.text: I know you're looking for more answers to many other questions, but you still don't have all the pieces to solve the whole puzzle.

units.rawText: Before then, allow me to find those missing pieces alongside you.
units.displayText: Before then, allow me to find those missing pieces alongside you.

spans.text: Before then, allow me to find those missing pieces alongside you.
